annotations.title: Look up a domain (registration, DNS, email provider)

description: For one domain: whether it is registered, its registrar, created, updated and expiry dates, status codes and nameservers (from the registry's RDAP server), plus its A, AAAA, MX, NS and TXT records, the email provider behind its MX, and whether it publishes SPF and DMARC. No registrant names or contact details are returned.

domain.description: A domain, URL or email address; the registered domain is used.
